extracted.summary: Fatima Whitlock has asked for a call about funding options for a client, without giving any details of the matter.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance. So that we can direct your enquiry to the right team, we would be grateful for some further detail: the type of matter (for example divorce/financial remedy or probate), where the proceedings or estate are based, the amount of funding being sought, and the value of the estate or assets in dispute. It would also help to know whether a solicitor is instructed and the name of the firm, the current stage of the matter, and any upcoming hearing or tax deadline. Please also confirm the best full telephone number and a convenient time to call. We will review the information once received.
